title: Protean Supply Chains: Ten Dynamics of Supply and Demand Alignment
description:
Features emerging trends that are shaping supply chain operations worldwide as well as impacting the global business landscape

Beginning with the assertion that supply chains are an overlooked factor behind anemic economic growth, Protean Supply Chains: Ten Dynamics of Supply and Demand Alignment provides a comprehensive overview of the developments occurring in the field of supply chain management. A broad range of topics in facility location, inventory, strategic sourcing, and supply chain coordination are addressed in addition to coverage of major developments within the field. The author's main position is that supply chains must be more than agile or flexible; rather, they must become protean and capable of changing shape in response to a volatile global business landscape.

The author, a well-known editor and researcher in the field, presents current real-world examples combined with insights into the impact of recent trends that are expected to affect the global business landscape over the next decade. Highlighting companies with leading-edge supply chains as examples, the book discusses methods to reduce spending, increase revenues, and achieve streamlined productivity in a changing economic climate. The book utilizes further examples from the growth of online retailing and automation in distribution centers, as well as the use of protean supply chains to gain competitive advantages internationally. In addition, the book features the following ten emerging trends, which are shaping supply chain operations worldwide:

The rise of regional theatres of supply

Global risk management through control towers

Customer segmentation

Real demand realization

Omniichannel retailing challenges

Demand swing alignment with production and distribution

Customer of one service

Sustainability challenges

Collaboration vs. competition in the new economy

Financial dynamism

The book is an ideal reference for professionals and practitioners in operations research, business/management science, applied mathematics, and industrial engineering as well as an appropriate supplement for undergraduate and graduate-level courses in supply chain management.

Se aborda una amplia gama de temas en la ubicación de las instalaciones, el inventario, la contratación estratégica y la coordinación de la cadena de suministro, además de la cobertura de los principales acontecimientos sobre el terreno. El autor, un conocido editor e investigador en el campo, presenta ejemplos actuales del mundo real combinados con información sobre el impacto de las tendencias recientes que se espera afectarán al panorama empresarial mundial durante el próximo decenio. El aumento de los teatros regionales de suministro

Gestión mundial del riesgo mediante torres de control

segmentación del cliente

title: Streamline Business with Consolidation and Conversion to DB2 for z/OS
description:
Time to market, flexibility, and cost reduction are among the top concerns common to all IT executives. If significant resource investments are placed in mature systems, IT organizations need to balance old and new technology. Older technology, such as non-IBM pre-relational databases, is costly, inflexible, and non-standard. Users store their information on the mainframe and thus preserve the skills and qualities of service their business needs. But users also benefit from standards-based modernization by migrating to IBM® DB2® for z/OS®. With this migration, users deliver new application features quickly and respond to changing business requirements more effectively.

When migrating, the main decision is choosing between conversion and re-engineering. Although the rewards associated with rebuilding mature applications are high, so are the risks and customers that are embarking on a migration need that migration done quickly.

In this IBM Redbooks® publication, we examine how to best approach the migration process by evaluating the environment, assessing the application as a conversion candidate, and identifying suitable tools.

This publication is intended for IT decision makers and database administrators who are considering migrating their information to a modern database management system.

Please note that the additional material referenced in the text is not available from IBM.
translatedDescription:
El tiempo para el mercado, la flexibilidad y la reducción de costos son una de las principales preocupaciones comunes a todos los ejecutivos de TI. Si se colocan importantes inversiones de recursos en sistemas maduros, las organizaciones de TI necesitan equilibrar la tecnología vieja y nueva. La tecnología más antigua, como las bases de datos prerelacionadas no IBM, es costosa, inflexible y no estándar. Los usuarios almacenan su información sobre el mainframe y así preservan las habilidades y cualidades del servicio que sus necesidades empresariales necesitan. Pero los usuarios también se benefician de la modernización basada en estándares migrando a IBM® DB2® para z/OS®. Con esta migración, los usuarios ofrecen nuevas funciones de aplicación rápidamente y responden a los cambios de requisitos de negocio más eficazmente.

Al emigrar, la decisión principal es elegir entre conversión y reingeniería. Aunque las recompensas asociadas con la reconstrucción de aplicaciones maduras son altas, también los riesgos y clientes que están embarcando en una migración necesitan que la migración se haga rápidamente.

En esta publicación IBM Redbooks® examinamos cómo abordar mejor el proceso de migración evaluando el medio ambiente, evaluando la aplicación como candidato a conversión e identificando herramientas adecuadas.

Esta publicación está destinada a los encargados de adoptar decisiones de TI y a los administradores de bases de datos que están considerando la posibilidad de migrar su información a un sistema moderno de gestión de bases de datos.

Tenga en cuenta que el material adicional mencionado en el texto no está disponible en el IBM.

title: Vanishing Boundaries, 2nd Edition
description: Presenting the innovative thesis that global competition and supply chain complexity are increasing so rapidly that managers must reach across the manufacturing and service boundary to gather more universally applicable ideas, this groundbreaking work addresses the unprecedented array of new or aggravated conditions that today‘s business managers must face. Businesses need to become more consumer-centric, efficient, and quality conscious. This book addresses problems, solutions, and implementation strategies as well as risk and crisis management, sourcing, healthcare, alternative energy infrastructure, integration of supply chain services, advances in IT, social media, and customer building.

Las empresas necesitan ser más conscientes de la calidad, centradas en el consumidor y eficientes. title: Governing Operational Decisions in an Enterprise Scalable Way
description:
This IBM® Redbooks® publication presents decision governance topics from a theoretical discussion perspective and then goes on to make links to the practical aspects of applying these concepts by using the IBM Operational Decision Manager platform.

This book explores enterprise governance context to clarify the bigger picture for how governance is carried out across the enterprise.

You will also find this book valuable if you are using or considering the usage of an operational decision management system (or business rules management system (BRMS)) in your organization. You might be following a standard such as the The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF) Architecture Development Method (ADM) and decided to use a decision management system that lets the business people take control of the business decisions that are made by the technology systems in their organization.

This book also describes Control Objectives for Information and Related Technology (COBIT), which provides a comprehensive framework that assists enterprises in achieving their objectives for the governance and management of enterprise IT.

Another topic of great importance that this book covers is the relationship to ITIL, a public framework that describes best practices in IT Service Management. Of the five stages of the ITIL lifecycle, this book focuses on the objectives and processes of the Service Transition stage.

Esta publicación IBM® Redbooks® presenta temas de gobernanza de decisiones desde una perspectiva de discusión teórica y luego sigue haciendo enlaces a los aspectos prácticos de la aplicación de estos conceptos utilizando la plataforma IBM Operational Decision Manager.

Este libro explora el contexto de gobernanza empresarial para aclarar el panorama más amplio de cómo se lleva a cabo la gobernanza en toda la empresa.

También encontrará este libro valioso si está utilizando o considerando el uso de un sistema operativo de gestión de decisiones (o sistema de gestión de reglas comerciales) en su organización. Usted podría estar siguiendo un estándar como el Marco de Arquitectura de Grupo Abierto (TOGAF) Método de Desarrollo de Arquitectura (ADM) y decidió utilizar un sistema de gestión de decisiones que permite a las personas de negocios tomar el control de las decisiones de negocio que son tomadas por los sistemas tecnológicos en su organización.

Este libro también describe los Objetivos de Control de la Información y la Tecnología Conexa (COBIT), que proporciona un marco amplio que ayuda a las empresas a alcanzar sus objetivos para la gobernanza y gestión de la TI empresarial.

title: New Ways of Running IBM z/OS Batch Applications
description:
Mainframe computers play a central role in the daily operations of many of the worlds largest corporations. Batch processing is still a fundamental, mission-critical component of the workloads that run on the mainframe and a large portion of the workload on IBM® z/OS® systems is processed in batch mode.

This IBM Redbooks® publication is the second volume in a series of four in which we describe new technologies introduced by IBM to facilitate the use of hybrid batch applications that combine the best aspects of Java and procedural programming languages such as COBOL. This volume specifically focuses on the z/OS batch runtime.

The audience for this book includes IT architects and application developers, with a focus on batch processing on the z/OS platform.

Please note that the additional material referenced in the text is not available from IBM.

title: Supply Chain Risk Management
description: One of the many outcomes resulting from the explosion of international trade is access to lower cost production opportunities through outsourcing. This phenomenon has increased the importance of supply chains, the information technology needed to coordinate them and the need for this relatively complex enterprise to be exceptionally well-managed. There are obviously many cost benefits to be had from maintaining a strong and far-reaching supply chain. However, this opportunity to lower costs entails significant risks, such as tsunamis, earthquakes, political unrest, and economic turbulence. This book will introduce concepts and examples of risk in supply chain management, followed by an identification and discussion of an array of quantitative tools (selection methods, risk simulation modeling, and business scorecard analysis) to help manage these risks. Many books are appearing that address various aspects of supply chain risks. No other book known to the author addresses this set of modeling tools as a means of managing this risk.
translatedDescription: Uno de los muchos resultados resultantes de la explosión del comercio internacional es el acceso a menores oportunidades de producción de costos mediante la contratación externa. Este fenómeno ha aumentado la importancia de las cadenas de suministro, la tecnología de la información necesaria para coordinarlas y la necesidad de que esta empresa relativamente compleja sea excepcionalmente bien gestionada. Es evidente que hay muchos beneficios de costos que se deben tener para mantener una cadena de suministro fuerte y de largo alcance. Sin embargo, esta oportunidad de reducir costos conlleva riesgos significativos, como tsunamis, terremotos, disturbios políticos y turbulencia económica. Este libro introducirá conceptos y ejemplos de riesgo en la gestión de la cadena de suministro, seguido de una identificación y discusión de una serie de herramientas cuantitativas (métodos de selección, modelado de simulación de riesgo y análisis de puntuación de negocios) para ayudar a gestionar estos riesgos. Muchos libros aparecen que abordan diversos aspectos de los riesgos de la cadena de suministro. Ningún otro libro conocido por el autor aborda este conjunto de herramientas de modelado como medio de gestionar este riesgo.

title: Learning Powershell DSC
description:
"Learning PowerShell DSC" provides a comprehensive guide to mastering Microsoft's Desired State Configuration (DSC) framework. It introduces foundational concepts essential for automating system configuration and deployment. Through hands-on examples, readers learn to create reusable DSC scripts and custom resources, useful for maintaining thousands of servers efficiently.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the core principles and architecture of PowerShell DSC for effective system configuration.
Learn to write flexible and maintainable DSC scripts applicable across various deployment scenarios.
Gain the skills to design and utilize custom DSC resources for tailored application settings.
Master techniques for deploying applications and configurations using both push and pull models.
Engage in practical application by implementing real-world scenarios like deploying a website using DSC.

Author(s)

James Pogran is an experienced system administrator and developer with vast expertise in configuration management and automation. He brings practical insights from industry leading practices to his writing, making complex concepts accessible and engaging. His passion for education ensures readers can apply the strategies proposed effectively in real-world environments.

Who is it for?

title: Business Applications of Operations Research
description: Operations Research is a bouquet of mathematical techniques which have evolved over the last six decades, to improve the process of business decision making. Operations Research offers tools to optimize and find the best solutions to myriad decisions that managers have to take in their day to day operations or while carrying out strategic planning. Today, with the advent of operations research software, these tools can be applied by managers even without any knowledge of the mathematical techniques that underlie the solution procedures. The book starts with a brief introduction to various tools of operations research, such as linear programming, integer programming, multi-objective programming, queuing theory and network theory together with simple examples in each of the areas. Another introductory chapter on handling the operations research software, along with examples is also provided. The book intends to make the readers aware of the power and potential of operations research in addressing decision making in areas of operations, supply chain, financial and marketing management. The approach of this book is to demonstrate the solution to specific problems in these areas using operations research techniques and software. The reader is encouraged to use the accompanying software models to solve these problems, using detailed do-it-yourself instructions. The intended outcome for readers of this book will be gaining familiarity and an intuitive understanding of the various tools of operations research and their applications to various business situations. It is expected that this will give the reader the ability and confidence to devise models for their own business needs.
translatedDescription: Operaciones Research es un ramo de técnicas matemáticas que han evolucionado en las últimas seis décadas, para mejorar el proceso de toma de decisiones de negocios. Operaciones Research ofrece herramientas para optimizar y encontrar las mejores soluciones a misriad decisiones que los administradores tienen que tomar en sus operaciones diarias o durante la realización de planificación estratégica. Hoy, con el advenimiento del software de investigación de operaciones, estas herramientas pueden ser aplicadas por los administradores incluso sin ningún conocimiento de las técnicas matemáticas que subyacen a los procedimientos de solución. El libro comienza con una breve introducción a varias herramientas de investigación de operaciones, tales como programación lineal, programación de enteros, programación multiobjetiva, teoría de apagado y teoría de la red junto con ejemplos simples en cada una de las áreas. También se proporciona otro capítulo introductorio sobre el manejo del software de investigación de operaciones, junto con ejemplos. El libro tiene la intención de que los lectores conozcan el poder y el potencial de la investigación de operaciones para abordar la toma de decisiones en áreas de operaciones, cadena de suministro, gestión financiera y de marketing. El enfoque de este libro es demostrar la solución a problemas específicos en estas áreas utilizando técnicas de investigación de operaciones y software. Se alienta al lector a utilizar los modelos de software que acompañan para resolver estos problemas, utilizando instrucciones detalladas do-it-yourself. El resultado previsto para los lectores de este libro será adquirir familiaridad y una comprensión intuitiva de las diversas herramientas de investigación de operaciones y sus aplicaciones a diversas situaciones empresariales. Se espera que esto le dé al lector la capacidad y la confianza para diseñar modelos para sus propias necesidades empresariales.

title: Operations Management for MBAs, 5th Edition
description:
Operations Management for MBAs provides an introduction to the basic concepts of operations management with a strategic, conceptual, and contemporary approach. Specifically written with the needs of MBA students in mind, current topics such as supply chain management, the balanced scorecard, and yield management, as well as those specific to marketing, finance and other majors are explained with less quantitative and more conceptual content.

With a concise format, this text is designed to allow professors to tailor the course through supplementary cases and other materials for the unique nature of various MBA programs and student populations.

Jack Meredith has written eight books on operations management, project management and management science, and his research focus is on the strategic and operational problems that managers face, particularly those concerning the management of advanced technology. Scott Shafer, one of the nation's first college professors to earn the Black Belt Six Sigma certification through the American Society for Quality (ASQ), integrates Six Sigma into educational programs as Director of MA Program and Professor of Management.

Scott Shafer, uno de los primeros profesores universitarios de la nación para ganar la certificación Black Belt Six Sigma a través de la Sociedad Americana de Calidad (ASQ), integra Six Sigma en programas educativos como Director del Programa MA y Profesor de Gestión.

title: X Power Tools
description:
This book puts you in charge of the most flexible and adaptable graphical interface in the computer industry. The X Window System underlies graphical desktops on Linux and Unix systems, and supports advanced features of modern graphics cards. More people use the X Window System than ever before, but there are few books about X in print. X Power Tools fills that hole with the most practical and up-to-date information available.Written in O'Reilly's popular Power Tools format, X Power Tools offers dozens of standalone articles, thoroughly cross-referenced, on useful tools and techniques for using X. This unique inside look at X gives Unix/Linux system administrators, owners of self-administered systems, and power users a lot of useful ways to harness the power of this system effectively. This book:

Offers a thorough grounding in X configuration and how the system works
Provides the complete ins and outs of changing a desktop's behavior, such as fonts, keyboard settings, and remote security
Includes articles on how to take advantage of X's "network transparency" -- its ability to display graphical applications on a remote machine
Explores intriguing areas such as using multiple monitors, building kiosks, and accessibility
Features discussions on X Window innovations and the future of the system
X Power Tools covers configuration and use of X, focusing on Linux but also including notes on other operating systems such as Solaris and FreeBSD. Each article in the book gives you insight into X; the entire book gives you a real grasp on this system and what you can do with it.

Más personas utilizan el sistema de ventana X que nunca antes, pero hay pocos libros sobre X en impresión. X Power Tools llena ese agujero con la información más práctica y actualizada disponible. title: Achieving and Sustaining Secured Business Operations: An Executive’s Guide to Planning and Management
description:
Proactively plan and manage innovation in your business while keeping operations safe and secure. This book provides a framework and practices to help you safeguard customer information, prevent unauthorized access, and protect your brand and assets.

Securing company operations is a board-level discussion. Across all industries, companies are pouring millions of dollars into taming cybercrime and other related security crime. Achieving and Sustaining Secured Business Operations presents a holistic approach looking top down, bottom up, and sideways. The end goal is to achieve and sustain a safe environment to conduct secured business operations while continuously innovating for competitive advantage.

Chief executive officers and their leadership team; chief operations officers; chief information officers and their leadership team; chief information security officers; business functional middle managers; and enterprise, solution, and information technology architects

This book is designed for IT professionals, Windows administrators, and curious learners who wish to efficiently master PowerShell scripting. It's perfect for individuals looking to improve their script development skills and expand their enterprise IT expertise. The guide is especially suitable for those new to PowerShell but aiming to achieve an in-depth and practical understanding of its capabilities.

Cree una herramienta completa de escaneado basado en PowerShell para el diagnóstico del servidor.

Su objetivo es empoderar a los lectores para lograr la confianza en sus capacidades de scripting.

Este libro está diseñado para profesionales de TI, administradores de Windows y curiosos estudiantes que desean dominar eficientemente PowerShell scripting. title: Supply Chain Risk Management for Macro Risks
description: This new case study focuses on the macro risks associated with relying on global supply chains. It addresses large events including floods, earthquakes, hurricanes, fires, and tornadoes; manmade disasters such as wars and economic crises; and technical disasters ranging from transport accidents and explosions to fires, gas leaks, and industrial accidents. Coverage includes risk classification; strategic, tactical, and operational issues; and a complete supply chain resilience model designed to help both students and practitioners effectively integrate macro risks into planning. Authors: Matthias Klumpp and Hella Abidi; both from FOM University of Applied Sciences.
translatedDescription: Este nuevo estudio de caso se centra en los riesgos macro asociados con la utilización de cadenas globales de suministro. Aborda grandes acontecimientos como inundaciones, terremotos, huracanes, incendios y tornados; desastres provocados por el hombre como guerras y crisis económicas; y desastres técnicos que van desde accidentes de transporte y explosiones hasta incendios, fugas de gas y accidentes industriales. La cobertura incluye la clasificación de riesgos; cuestiones estratégicas, tácticas y operacionales; y un modelo completo de resiliencia de la cadena de suministro diseñado para ayudar a estudiantes y profesionales a integrar eficazmente los riesgos macro en la planificación. Autores: Matthias Klumpp y Hella Abidi; ambos de la Universidad FOM de Ciencias Aplicadas.

title: Beginning Modern Unix: Learn to Live Comfortably in a Modern Unix Environment
description:
Discover how to leverage modern Unix even if you’ve never worked with Unix before. This book presents everything in conceptual terms that you can understand, rather than tips to be committed raw to memory.

You will learn everyday tasks ranging from basic system administration—partitioning and mounting filesystems, software installation, network configuration, working from the command line) — to Bourne shell scripting, using graphical applications, as well as fanciful things  such as emulation layers for Windows and Linux and virtualization with VirtualBox.

It’s now 50 years since the creation of Unix but it is still growing. As Unix now moves to everyone's OS (open-source FreeBSD/Linux), it is the perfect time to start your journey with Beginning Modern Unix as your guide. 

What You'll Learn

Live comfortably in a modern Unix environment, both on the command-line and in the graphical world. 
Choose the right hardware for Unix
Work with Unix in real world settings
Develop Unix applications
Review advanced techniques in Shell scripting

Who This Book Is For

Everyone who uses a computer – those who intend to migrate to Unix as well as those who are worried about migrating to Unix, perhaps fearing it is a pure command-line or ‘difficult’ world.
translatedDescription:
Descubre cómo aprovechar el Unix moderno incluso si nunca has trabajado con Unix antes. Este libro presenta todo en términos conceptuales que usted puede entender, en lugar de consejos para ser comprometidos crudo a la memoria.

Aprenderás tareas cotidianas que van desde la administración básica del sistema —partitioning y mounting filesystems, instalación de software, configuración de red, trabajando desde la línea de comandos) — hasta Bourne shell scripting, utilizando aplicaciones gráficas, así como cosas fantasias como capas de emulación para Windows y Linux y virtualización con VirtualBox.

Ahora son 50 años desde la creación de Unix pero sigue creciendo. A medida que Unix ahora se mueve a todo el sistema operativo (fuente abierto FreeBSD/Linux), es el momento perfecto para iniciar su viaje con Beginning Modern Unix como su guía.

Lo que aprenderás

Vive cómodamente en un ambiente moderno Unix, tanto en la línea de comandos como en el mundo gráfico.
Elija el hardware adecuado para Unix
Trabaja con Unix en la configuración del mundo real
Desarrollar aplicaciones Unix
Revise técnicas avanzadas en Shell scripting

Quién es este libro

Todos los que usan una computadora – los que tienen la intención de migrar a Unix, así como los que están preocupados por migrar a Unix, quizás temer que sea un mundo puro de línea de comandos o ‘dificultismo’.

title: Pro PowerShell for Amazon Web Services
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading public cloud platform. In this book you will learn to use Microsoft PowerShell to create, host, manage, and administer workloads using Amazon Web Services. You will learn how to create virtual machines, provision storage, configure networks, and more—all using your preferred Windows scripting language.

CIOs everywhere are leading their organizations to the cloud, but there are few books available to help. This book focuses on moving Microsoft Windows workloads to the cloud using technologies familiar to enterprise Microsoft-based professionals.

The completely revised and expanded Pro PowerShell for Amazon Web Services is written specifically for Windows professionals who already know PowerShell and want to learn to host Windows workloads on Amazon Web Services. The cloud offers information technology workers significant cost savings and agility unimaginable even just a few years ago. Tasks that traditionally took weeksof work, costing thousands of dollars, can be completed in minutes for a fraction of a penny.

New chapters in this second edition cover: AWS Lambda, Amazon WorkSpaces, Amazon AppStream 2.0, AWS Directory Service, Amazon WorkDocs, and AWS System Manager.

What You'll Learn

Create and manage Windows servers on Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2)
Configure and secure networks with Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
Leverage autoscaling to adjust resources as load changes
Deploy and manage SQL Server using the Relational Database Service (RDS)
Manage virtual desktops using WorkSpaces and AppStream
Leverage AWS Systems Manager to manage Windows at scale

Who This Book Is For

Windows professionals who want to learn more about Amazon Web Services, with a focus on running Windows workloads andautomated management at scale using PowerShell tools for AWS. The book assumes you have knowledge of Windows and PowerShell, but are new to AWS.
translatedDescription:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) es la plataforma de nube pública líder. En este libro aprenderás a utilizar Microsoft PowerShell para crear, acoger, gestionar y administrar cargas de trabajo utilizando Amazon Web Services. Aprenderás a crear máquinas virtuales, almacenamiento de provisiones, configurar redes y mucho más, usando tu lenguaje de scripting Windows preferido.

CIOs en todas partes están llevando a sus organizaciones a la nube, pero hay pocos libros disponibles para ayudar. Este libro se centra en mover las cargas de trabajo de Microsoft Windows a la nube utilizando tecnologías familiares a profesionales basados en Microsoft.

El Pro PowerShell completamente revisado y ampliado para Amazon Web Services está escrito específicamente para profesionales de Windows que ya conocen PowerShell y quieren aprender a acoger cargas de trabajo de Windows en Amazon Web Services. La nube ofrece a los trabajadores de tecnología de la información ahorros significativos y agilidad inimaginable incluso hace unos años. Tareas que tradicionalmente tomaron semanas de trabajo, costando miles de dólares, se pueden completar en minutos por una fracción de un centavo.

Nuevos capítulos en esta segunda edición cubren: AWS Lambda, Amazon WorkSpaces, Amazon AppStream 2.0, AWS Directory Service, Amazon WorkDocs y AWS System Manager.

Lo que aprenderás

Crear y administrar servidores de Windows en Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2)
Configurar y asegurar redes con Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
Aprovechar la autoescalificación para ajustar los recursos como cambios de carga
Implementar y administrar SQL Server usando el Servicio de Bases de Datos Relacionales (RDS)
Gestione los escritorios virtuales usando WorkSpaces y AppStream
Leverage AWS Systems Manager para administrar Windows a escala

Quién es este libro

Profesionales de Windows que quieren aprender más sobre Amazon Web Services, con un enfoque en ejecutar cargas de trabajo de Windows y administración automatizada a escala utilizando herramientas PowerShell para AWS. El libro supone que usted tiene conocimiento de Windows y PowerShell, pero son nuevos en AWS.

title: Essential PowerShell for Office 365: Managing and Automating Skills for Improved Productivity
description:
Take your Office 365 skills to the next level. Master PowerShell for Office 365 to stay competitive in today’s world of highly sought after cloud management skills. With expert guidance, IT pros will learn how to leverage the muscle of PowerShell to automate many advanced administrative tasks not otherwise accessible in the Office 365 Admin Center. You will discover how to unlock configuration options and automate tasks in order to free up valuable time and resources.

This book is your companion to administering Office 365 with PowerShell. You will learn time-saving techniques such as how to streamline administrative tasks, and how to manage users, licenses, and Office 365 services. Expert and MVP Vlad Catrinescu introduces each chapter with an overview and basic fundamentals, such as how to connect to your required service in Office 365, so that you have a solid foundation for success. Benefit from learning the theory behind PowerShell for Office 365 and put your knowledge topractice with numerous hands-on code examples.

What You’ll Learn

Manage users in bulk
Export data such as user lists and groups
Create and manage Office 365 groups
Manage Exchange online distribution lists, mailboxes, and contacts
Configure Skype for Business settings
Perform compliance searches directly from PowerShell

Who This Book Is For

Any IT pro who needs to manage Office 365 or one of its services such as Exchange, SharePoint, or Skype for Business. Readers should have a basic knowledge of PowerShell and the Office 365 service they want to manage.
translatedDescription:
Lleva tus habilidades de Office 365 al siguiente nivel. Master PowerShell para Office 365 para mantenerse competitivo en el mundo actual de habilidades de gestión de nubes muy buscadas. Con guía experta, los profesionales de TI aprenderán a aprovechar el músculo de PowerShell para automatizar muchas tareas administrativas avanzadas que no son de otra manera accesibles en el Centro de Admin de Office 365. Usted descubrirá cómo desbloquear opciones de configuración y automatizar tareas para liberar tiempo y recursos valiosos.

Este libro es su compañero de administración de Office 365 con PowerShell. Aprenderá técnicas de ahorro de tiempo tales como cómo simplificar las tareas administrativas, y cómo gestionar los usuarios, licencias y servicios de Office 365. Experto y MVP Vlad Catrinescu presenta cada capítulo con una visión general y fundamentos básicos, como cómo conectarse a su servicio requerido en Office 365, para que tenga una sólida base para el éxito. Benefíciese de aprender la teoría detrás de PowerShell para Office 365 y poner sus conocimientos topractice con numerosos ejemplos de código práctico.

Lo que aprenderás

Gestionar usuarios a granel
Exportar datos como listas de usuarios y grupos
Crear y gestionar grupos Office 365
Gestionar listas de distribución online, buzones de correo y contactos
Configurar Skype para configuraciones de negocios
Realizar búsquedas de cumplimiento directamente desde PowerShell

Quién es este libro

Cualquier profesional de TI que necesite gestionar Office 365 o uno de sus servicios como Exchange, SharePoint o Skype for Business. Los lectores deben tener un conocimiento básico de PowerShell y el servicio Office 365 que quieren gestionar.

title: Making Process Improvement Work for Service Organizations: A Concise Action Guide
description:
Process improvement too often reflects a significant disconnect between theory and practice. Making Process Improvement Work for Service Organizations bridges the gap–offering a straightforward, systematic approach to planning, implementing, and monitoring a process improvement program. Managers and practitioners will appreciate the book’s concise presentation style and will be able to apply its practical ideas immediately to real-life challenges.

With examples based on the authors’ own extensive experience, this book shows how to define goals that directly address the needs of your organization, use improvement models appropriately, and devise a pragmatic action plan. In addition, it reveals valuable strategies for deploying organizational change, and delineates essential metrics for tracking your progress. Appendices provide examples of an action plan, a risk management plan, and a mini-assessment process.

You will learn how to

Scope and develop an improvement plan

Identify and prioritize risks and mitigate anticipated difficulties

Derive metrics that accurately measure progress toward business goals

Sell your improvement program in house

Initially target practitioners and teams most open to new approaches and techniques

Stay focused on goals and problems

Align the actions of managers and practitioners

Delay major policy documents and edicts until solutions have been practiced and tested

Use existing resources to speed deployment

Incorporate improvement models, such as SEI CMMISM for Services, into your improvement program

For those managers who are tired of chronic problems during service creation and delivery, constant new improvement schemes, and a lack of real progress, this easily digestible volume provides the real-world wisdom you need to realize positive change in your organization.
translatedDescription:
La mejora del proceso suele reflejar una importante desconexión entre la teoría y la práctica. La labor de mejora de procesos para las organizaciones de servicios reduce la brecha que ofrece un enfoque sencillo y sistemático para planificar, implementar y supervisar un programa de mejora de procesos. Los gerentes y profesionales apreciarán el estilo de presentación conciso del libro y podrán aplicar sus ideas prácticas inmediatamente a los desafíos de la vida real.

Con ejemplos basados en la amplia experiencia de los autores, este libro muestra cómo definir metas que abordan directamente las necesidades de su organización, utilizar modelos de mejora apropiadamente y diseñar un plan de acción pragmático. Además, revela estrategias valiosas para el despliegue del cambio organizativo, y define métricas esenciales para el seguimiento de su progreso. Los apéndices proporcionan ejemplos de un plan de acción, un plan de gestión de riesgos y un proceso de minievaluación.

Aprenderás cómo

Alcance y elaboración de un plan de mejora

Determinar y priorizar los riesgos y mitigar las dificultades previstas

métricas destructivas que miden con precisión el progreso hacia los objetivos de negocio

Vender su programa de mejora en casa

Inicialmente dirigidos a profesionales y equipos más abiertos a nuevos enfoques y técnicas

Manténgase enfocado en metas y problemas

Alinear las acciones de los administradores y profesionales

Delay major policy documents and edicts until solutions have been practiced and testing

Utilización de los recursos existentes para acelerar el despliegue

Incorporar modelos de mejora, como SEI CMMISM for Services, en su programa de mejora

Para aquellos administradores que están cansados de problemas crónicos durante la creación de servicios y la entrega, constantes nuevos esquemas de mejora, y una falta de progreso real, este volumen fácilmente digestible proporciona la sabiduría del mundo real que necesita para realizar cambios positivos en su organización.

title: Global Sourcing Logistics: How to Manage Risk and Gain Competitive Advantage in a Worldwide Marketplace
description:
More than ever, global sourcing is an economic necessity for companies large and small, and in every industry. But with advantages in price and terms come new risks that businesses must approach effectively lest their supply chain -- and ultimately the whole enterprise -- be undermined.

Global Sourcing Logistics offers businesses a blueprint for creating standard operating procedures for managing the risks of their inbound supply chains. Filled with hands-on solutions to the challenges of global commerce, the book covers:

* reasons to (or not to) source globally * measuring the risks versus those of other sourcing alternatives * how to reduce landed costs * compliance management and new Customs and Homeland Security issues * insurance, liability, and loss control * and much more

A must-have resource for all sourcing, supply chain, risk management, and import/export professionals, the book features tools for creating a comprehensive program to ensure competitive advantage while avoiding the pitfalls that can undermine even powerful businesses and seasoned supply chain veterans.
translatedDescription:
Más que nunca, la contratación mundial es una necesidad económica para las empresas grandes y pequeñas, y en cada industria. Pero con ventajas en el precio y los términos surgen nuevos riesgos que las empresas deben abordar eficazmente para que su cadena de suministro -- y en última instancia toda la empresa -- sea socavada.

Global Sourcing Logistics ofrece a las empresas un plan para crear procedimientos operativos estándar para gestionar los riesgos de sus cadenas de suministro inbound. Repleto de soluciones prácticas a los retos del comercio mundial, el libro cubre:

* razones para (o no a) fuente globalmente * medición de los riesgos frente a los de otras alternativas de abastecimiento * cómo reducir los costos aterrizados * gestión de cumplimiento y nuevos problemas de aduanas y seguridad en el país * seguro, responsabilidad y control de pérdidas * y mucho más

Un recurso imprescindible para todos los profesionales de abastecimiento, cadena de suministro, gestión de riesgos y importación/exportación, el libro cuenta con herramientas para crear un programa integral para asegurar una ventaja competitiva, evitando al mismo tiempo los obstáculos que pueden socavar incluso las empresas poderosas y veteranos experimentados de la cadena de suministro.

title: Managing Global Supply Chains
description: The events of September 11, 2001 had a profound impact not only upon individuals, institutions, and governments, but also upon global trade. The reverberations of this focused act of terrorism are manifest in much more stringent logistics, documentary requirements, and regulations. A single source on compliance and security, Managing Global Supply Chains frames a comprehensive strategy for supply chain executives in the post 9/11 world. It delineates problems and changes in rules and regulations, discusses vocabulary and acronyms, and teaches executives to implement mandatory compliance and security programs as a means of preserving expeditious global supply chains.
translatedDescription: Los acontecimientos del 11 de septiembre de 2001 tuvieron un profundo impacto no sólo en individuos, instituciones y gobiernos, sino también en el comercio mundial. Las reverberaciones de este acto específico de terrorismo se manifiestan en logística, requisitos documentales y regulaciones mucho más estrictas. Una única fuente de cumplimiento y seguridad, Managing Global Supply Chains enmarca una estrategia integral para ejecutivos de cadena de suministro en el mundo posterior al 11 de septiembre. Delinea problemas y cambios en las reglas y regulaciones, discute vocabulario y siglas, y enseña a los ejecutivos a implementar programas obligatorios de cumplimiento y seguridad como medio de preservar rápidas cadenas globales de suministro.

title: Developing Sustainable Supply Chains to Drive Value
Supplier Selection at Kerneos, Inc.
description: This new supply chain management case study examines supplier selection at Kerneos, Inc., a leading manufacturer of cement products based on alumina content. It describes the critical role of supplier selection in Kerneos's supply chain transformation, which is using new IT tools to link distribution and sales demand more tightly with production planning and placing far greater emphasis on working capital. Focusing on realistic issues and challenges throughout, this case study offers exceptional value to both students and practitioners. Authors: Ling Li and Erika Marsillac, Old Dominion University; Ted Kosiek, Kerneos, Inc.
translatedDescription: Este nuevo estudio de casos de gestión de la cadena de suministro examina la selección de proveedores en Kerneos, Inc., un fabricante líder de productos de cemento basados en el contenido de alumina. Describe el papel crítico de la selección de proveedores en la transformación de la cadena de suministro de Kerneos, que está utilizando nuevas herramientas de TI para vincular la distribución y las ventas demandan más estrictamente con la planificación de la producción y haciendo mayor hincapié en el capital de trabajo. Centrándose en cuestiones y desafíos realistas en todo el mundo, este estudio ofrece un valor excepcional tanto para estudiantes como para profesionales. Autores: Ling Li y Erika Marsillac, Old Dominion University; Ted Kosiek, Kerneos, Inc.

title: PowerShell™ for SharePoint® 2010 How-To
description:
No-nonsense, step-by-step PowerShell scripts and tools for solving real problems in SharePoint environments: fast, accurate, easy to use!

A concise, task-based guide for every SharePoint 2010 IT professional, including administrators, developers, and architects

Tested PowerShell scripts and techniques for managing servers, farms, IIS, users, services, sites, data, solutions, and enterprise services: an indispensable resource, organized for easy access and use

By leading SharePoint solutions developer Steven Mann

Using PowerShell, IT professionals can streamline the management of SharePoint 2010 servers, farms, sites, features, data, users, enterprise services, and more. Now, there's a single source for all the reliable PowerShell solutions they're looking for: PowerShell for SharePoint 2010 How-To. Leading business collaboration solutions developer Steven Mann presents concise tutorials to get SharePoint professionals up to speed, and walks through dozens of solutions, providing annotated scripts and step-by-step instructions for each. Logically organized for easy reference, this book's coverage includes: installing SharePoint more efficiently; configuring server farms; creating user and service accounts; administering sites and data; managing IIS; utilizing Excel Services, Access Services, and Visio Graphic Services; integrating PerformancePoint business intelligence capabilities; working with Enterprise Search, and much more. This concise, low-cost book goes far beyond "tips and tricks" to serve as the daily reference resource for every IT professional who wants to solve real problems with SharePoint 2010 and PowerShell.

title: Unix: Visual QuickStart Guide
description:
UNIX is the most commonly-used operating system in the world. Once considered too arcane and difficult for the creative user to learn, it is now used daily by millions of Internet users and developers. It's the system the Internet is built on. The task of learning UNIX, with its seemingly complicated commands and hundreds of different flavors, can seem daunting without a straightforward guide.

UNIX: Visual QuickStart Guide is the easiest way to get going with UNIX. The unique Visual QuickStart presentation strips away the mystery and technical jargon that surround this system. Simple step-by-step instructions, backed up with graphics and illustrations, guide readers through commands and applications both common and obscure. Beginners will applaud theVisual QuickStart Guide's uncomplicated approach, and seasoned UNIX users will find it to be an invaluable reference.

Es el sistema en el que se construye Internet. La tarea de aprender UNIX, con sus comandos aparentemente complicados y cientos de sabores diferentes, puede parecer desalentadora sin una guía directa.

UNIX: Visual QuickStart Guía es la manera más fácil de ir con UNIX. La presentación de Visual QuickStart despoja el misterio y la jerga técnica que rodea este sistema. Instrucciones simples paso a paso, respaldadas por gráficos e ilustraciones, lectores guía a través de comandos y aplicaciones tanto comunes como oscuros. Los principiantes aplauden el enfoque sin complicaciones de la Guía Virtual QuickStart, y los usuarios de UNIX experimentados encontrarán que es una referencia invaluable.

title: Making Process Improvement Work: A Concise Action Guide for Software Managers and Practitioners
description:
“This book hits the mark for three important issues:

How to keep focused on real improvements

How to develop an implementable improvement plan

How to develop meaningful and useful measurements

I will definitely recommend it to my clients who are just beginning or are having trouble with their improvement program.” —Norman Hammock, SEI Authorized Lead Assessor

“At last a common sense and business-oriented approach to process improvement. This book gives very practical instruction that is easy to apply. Your people will thank you for it.”—Nancy K. M. Rees, Vice President and Chief Engineer, Xerox Corporation

“...gets right to the heart of process improvement with specific, concrete steps and excellent examples. It’s a book you can use today.”—Dennis J. Frailey, Principal Fellow, Raytheon Company

“Too many organizations develop a checklist mentality targeted at achieving the next process maturity level or passing an audit...Neil and Mary remind us to focus on pragmatic mechanisms for achieving superior business results...”—Karl Wiegers, Principal Consultant, Process Impact

Software process improvement too often reflects a significant disconnect between theory and practice. This book bridges the gap—offering a straightforward, systematic approach to planning, implementing, and monitoring a process improvement program. Project managers will appreciate the book’s concise presentation style and will be able to apply its practical ideas immediately to real-life challenges.

With examples based on the authors’ own extensive experience, this book shows how to define goals that directly address the needs of your organization, use improvement models appropriately, and devise a pragmatic action plan. In addition, it reveals valuable strategies for deploying organizational change, and delineates essential metrics for tracking your progress. Appendices provide examples of an action plan, a risk management plan, and a mini-assessment process.

You will learn how to:

Scope and develop an improvement plan

Identify and prioritize risks and mitigate anticipated difficulties

Derive metrics that accurately measure progress toward business goals

Sell your improvement program in-house

Initially target practitioners and projects most-open to new approaches and techniques

Stay focused on goals and problems

Align the actions of managers and practitioners

Delay major policy documents and edicts until solutions have been practiced and tested

Use existing resources to speed deployment

Incorporate improvement models, such as SEI CMM® and CMMISM, into your improvement program

For those managers who are tired of chronic project difficulties, constant new improvement schemes, and a lack of real progress, this easily digestible volume provides the real-world wisdom you need to realize positive change in your organization.

title: Intelligent Manufacturing
description: The Madrid International Plan of Action on Ageing (MIPAA), adopted at the Second World Assembly on Ageing, is the first international agreement that specifically recognises the potential of older people to contribute to the development of their societies. In monitoring its implementation two key approaches are evident: a qualitative bottom-up participatory approach and an approach that uses quantitative indicators to monitor sustainable progress and policies. With the European Centre for Social Welfare Policy and Research, playing a pivotal role in the monitoring of the implementation process, one of its key tasks has been to develop a list of 'indicators of achievement'. This book contains extended and revised versions of policy briefs and background papers that support the implementation monitoring process. The analyses included in these chapters make concrete suggestions towards quantitative indicators, with the aim of assisting national governments in mainstreaming ageing in their policies. The contributors provide an overview of the current situation with respect to population ageing and its consequences and also provide projections for the future. The book also includes the final list of quantitative indicators that arose out of consultations with international experts, related to the four main topics addressed: demography, income and wealth, labour market participation, and social protection and financial sustainability.
translatedDescription: El Plan de Acción Internacional de Madrid sobre el Envejecimiento (MIPAA), aprobado en la Segunda Asamblea Mundial sobre el Envejecimiento, es el primer acuerdo internacional que reconoce específicamente el potencial de las personas de edad para contribuir al desarrollo de sus sociedades. En la supervisión de su aplicación son evidentes dos enfoques fundamentales: un enfoque participativo de abajo arriba cualitativo y un enfoque que utiliza indicadores cuantitativos para supervisar el progreso y las políticas sostenibles. Con el Centro Europeo de Política e Investigación de Bienestar Social, que desempeña un papel fundamental en la vigilancia del proceso de implementación, una de sus tareas clave ha sido desarrollar una lista de "indicadores de progreso". Este libro contiene versiones ampliadas y revisadas de informes de políticas y documentos de antecedentes que apoyan el proceso de vigilancia de la aplicación. Los análisis incluidos en estos capítulos hacen sugerencias concretas hacia indicadores cuantitativos, con el objetivo de ayudar a los gobiernos nacionales a incorporar el envejecimiento en sus políticas. Los contribuyentes ofrecen una visión general de la situación actual con respecto al envejecimiento de la población y sus consecuencias y también proporcionan proyecciones para el futuro. El libro también incluye la lista final de indicadores cuantitativos que surgieron de consultas con expertos internacionales, relacionados con los cuatro temas principales abordados: demografía, ingresos y riqueza, participación en el mercado de trabajo y protección social y sostenibilidad financiera.
